mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_title WHERE status <> 'DELETED') AS total_titles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_title WHERE status <> 'DELETED' AND title_type = 'MOVIE') AS movie_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_title WHERE status <> 'DELETED' AND title_type = 'SERIES') AS series_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_title WHERE status <> 'DELETED' AND is_animation = 1) AS animation_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_title WHERE status = 'DELETED') AS deleted_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_season) AS season_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_episode) AS episode_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_person) AS person_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_person WHERE name_only = 1) AS name_only_person_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.entity_id) FROM content_external_id e JOIN content_title t ON t.title_id = e.entity_id AND t.status <> 'DELETED' WHERE e.entity_type = 'TITLE') AS titles_with_external_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_localization l JOIN content_title t ON t.title_id = l.title_id AND t.status <> 'DELETED' WHERE l.lang_code = 'ko') AS titles_with_ko, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movies) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MergedTVShow) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cartoon_video) AS legacy_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legacy_change_log WHERE applied_at IS NULL) AS pending_changes, (SELECT MIN(changed_at) FROM legacy_change_log WHERE applied_at IS NULL) AS oldest_pending_change_at

SELECT CASE WHEN is_animation = 1 THEN CONCAT(title_type, '_ANIMATION') ELSE title_type END AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM content_title WHERE status <> 'DELETED' GROUP BY label ORDER BY cnt DESC, label

SELECT g.name_ko AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM content_title_genre tg JOIN content_genre g ON g.genre_code = tg.genre_code JOIN content_title t ON t.title_id = tg.title_id AND t.status <> 'DELETED' GROUP BY g.genre_code, g.name_ko ORDER BY cnt DESC, label LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(YEAR(release_date) AS CHAR), '미상') AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM content_title WHERE status <> 'DELETED' GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM content_title GROUP BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC, label

SELECT p.provider AS label, COUNT(e.external_id_seq) AS cnt FROM (SELECT 'TMDB_MOVIE' AS provider UNION ALL SELECT 'TMDB_TV' UNION ALL SELECT 'TMDB_PERSON' UNION ALL SELECT 'IMDB' UNION ALL SELECT 'KOBIS') p LEFT JOIN content_external_id e ON e.provider = p.provider GROUP BY p.provider ORDER BY cnt DESC, label
SELECT lang_code AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM content_localization GROUP BY lang_code ORDER BY cnt DESC, label

SELECT CONCAT(severity, ' ', issue_type) AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM migration_issue WHERE run_id = (SELECT MAX(run_id) FROM migration_issue) GROUP BY severity, issue_type ORDER BY severity, cnt DESC

SELECT DATE(started_at) AS run_date, job_name, SUM(status = 'SUCCESS') AS success_count, SUM(status = 'FAILED') AS failed_count, SUM(sla_breached) AS sla_breached_count, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, finished_at)) / 1000) AS avg_duration_ms FROM batch_job_run WHERE started_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY GROUP BY DATE(started_at), job_name ORDER BY run_date, job_name
